info.name: Snowplow Console Authentication Data Structures API
info.description:
The Snowplow Console API provides programmatic management of the Snowplow behavioral data platform. Covers data structures (JSON schemas), data products (tracking plans), event specifications, and credentials management. All endpoints are scoped to an organization and require JWT bearer authentication obtained via the Credentials API.

Contact Support:
 Name: Snowplow Support
